entities.summary: The Diocese of Kalookan is a diocese of the Latin Rite of the Catholic Church in Metro Manila, Philippines which comprises Malabon, Navotas, and the southern half of Caloocan. Northern half of Caloocan including Barangay 164 or Talipapa meanwhile lies entirely with the church jurisdiction of the Diocese of Novaliches.
